name: spec-workflow
description: Spec-driven development workflows for requirements, design, bug fixes, quick specs, task planning, and execution.

interface.shortDescription: Turn requirements, designs, and bug reports into executable specifications.
interface.longDescription: Guide feature and bug-fix work through requirements-first, design-first, bugfix, or quick-spec workflows. Produce approved requirements, designs with correctness properties, dependency-ordered tasks, progress status, and focused task execution.
defaultPrompt: Create a spec for this feature: [describe the feature]
Plan a surgical fix for this bug: [describe the bug]
Show the status of my current specification
